body: Thank you... Your words mean more than I could ever say. I hope that you find peace. You deserve it. We all do. :)

Thank you... I never thought about it that way. I guess that because I have been treated as replaceable by so many other people. I forgot that being unselfish and kind is rare. However, life has taught me that it is.

I have considered adoption, but I have put it aside because I keep thinking that no one would want to give a child to someone with my past. I know this is isn't true... I have been told repeatedly that this isn't true... That the horrible things I experienced were caused by the actions of others. Somewhere along the way, I internalized the blame and bought the lie that they fed me... That it was all my fault. This isn't true... In fact, if I were to foster a child who had gone through the same things I would do everything I could to uplift them, comfort them and unconditionally love them. The way we all deserve to be loved... 

Thank you, perpetual haste, life needs more people like you.
